input.query: change invoice delivery address where invoices sent

output.title: Changing your billing email address
output.content: To change the email address that receives invoices, go to Account Settings > Billing > Billing Contact and update the email field. This does not change your login email.

output.title: Upgrading from Free to Pro plan
output.content: Upgrade from Account Settings > Billing > Change Plan. The Pro plan is billed immediately on a prorated basis for the remainder of your current billing cycle, then at the full rate from the next cycle onward.

output.title: Refund policy — subscription cancellation
output.content: You can cancel your subscription at any time from Account Settings > Billing. Cancellation takes effect at the end of your current billing period. We do not issue partial refunds for unused days in the current period.

output.title: API rate limits
output.content: The API allows 100 requests per minute on the Free and Pro plans, and 1000 requests per minute on the Enterprise plan. Exceeding the limit returns an HTTP 429 response with a Retry-After header.

output.title: Upgrading from Free to Pro plan

output.title: Known issue: dashboard slow to load with 10,000+ rows
output.content: Dashboards with more than 10,000 rows currently load slowly because pagination is not yet applied server-side. Workaround: filter the dashboard by date range to reduce the row count. A server-side pagination fix is on the roadmap but has no committed release date.

steps.rawOutput:
To change where invoices are sent, go to **Account Settings > Billing > Billing Contact** and update the email address there. This won't affect your login email.

For the API limit on Pro, the Pro plan allows **100 requests per minute**. If you exceed this limit, you'll get an HTTP 429 response with a Retry-After header. If you need higher limits, the Enterprise plan offers 1000 requests per minute.
